answer: Before a first payout, the account must bridge one bank transfer of 10,000 rupiah from an account in the holder's own name, sent through a single narrow inlet to the juniper escrow account with a unique reference code. Two verifiers match the reference against the bank record within three days and confirm the account name matches the holder. A transfer from an account already linked to another POA account is refused and both accounts are closed. An honest user makes one small transfer once; 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 distinct bank accounts, each opened with real identity documents.
